name: Elizabeth Tower (Big Ben)
description: The Gothic clock tower at Westminster is widely known as Big Ben, properly the name of the Great Bell.

name: Tower of London
description: A riverside fortress that has served as palace, prison and treasury. The Crown Jewels are displayed inside.

name: Stonehenge
description: Prehistoric sarsen stones stand on Salisbury Plain. A visitor path circles the circle at a respectful distance.

name: Edinburgh Castle
description: A volcanic-rock fortress dominates Edinburgh’s Old Town. The One o’Clock Gun and crown jewels draw daily crowds.

name: Roman Baths
description: Ancient bathing rooms surround a green hot spring in the city centre. Georgian baths sit above the Roman levels.

name: British Museum
description: A vast free museum around a glass-covered Great Court. Galleries span Egypt, Greece and far beyond.

name: Lake District National Park
description: Glacial lakes and fells fill England’s best-known national park. Ambleside and Keswick are common bases.

name: Giant’s Causeway
description: Basalt columns step into the Atlantic on Northern Ireland’s coast. Boardwalks lead across the hexagonal stones.

name: Tower Bridge
description: A bascule bridge with twin towers frames the Pool of London. Glass walkways sit high above the Thames.

name: Cotswolds villages
description: Honey-stone villages and walking trails spread across rolling hills in south-central England.

name: Borough Market
description: A historic food market by London Bridge sells produce, cheese and hot street food under iron-and-glass roofs.

name: Stockbridge market
description: A neighbourhood known for cafés, delis and a Sunday market beside the Water of Leith.

name: Cardiff Market
description: A Victorian indoor market in Cardiff sells Welsh cakes, produce and casual bites.

name: St George’s Market
description: Belfast’s covered Victorian market fills with local producers and lunch stalls at weekends.

name: The Barras
description: A weekend market district in Glasgow’s East End with street food, vintage stalls and music venues nearby.

name: Edinburgh Hogmanay
description: Scotland’s capital hosts one of the world’s large New Year street parties with concerts and a fireworks finale.
